issues.description: The template Lecture class declares addGuestStudents with two parameters (int numberOfNewGuestStudents, boolean validateInput), but the problem statement (UML and tasks) and the solution implementation expect a single-parameter method addGuestStudents(int). This mismatch will confuse students and cause compilation or test failures because method signatures do not align across artifacts.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the template method signature to match the specification and solution: declare addGuestStudents as public void addGuestStudents(int numberOfNewGuestStudents) (remove the boolean parameter). Alternatively, if input validation is required, implement it internally or provide an overloaded helper method, but keep the public API matching the UML and tests.
